style.usage: Inline the SVG when currentColor inheritance is required. Raster and CSS-mask exports may be derived from these masters.

brandMarks.name: dmforge-mark-optical-16
brandMarks.usage: favicon-scale product identity and very compact controls
brandMarks.simplification16: Two whiskers per side, one angular A-detail per ear, simplified cloak seams, and only three principal die-facet directions.

brandMarks.name: dmforge-mark-optical-24
brandMarks.usage: toolbar brand mark, empty-state identity, compact avatar fallback
brandMarks.simplification16: If forced to 16px, use the dedicated 16px asset rather than scaling this file.

brandMarks.name: dmforge-mark-optical-32
brandMarks.usage: app header, character fallback, compact branded panels
brandMarks.simplification16: Never scale directly to 16px; switch to dmforge-mark-optical-16.

icons.name: character-card
icons.usage: character sheet, identity panel and dossier entry
icons.simplification16: Keep card frame, head circle and two text rules; remove the shortest third text rule if needed.

icons.name: backpack
icons.simplification16: Remove top handle interior rule; retain pack outline, straps and main pocket seam.

icons.name: biography
icons.simplification16: Retain portrait circle and one text rule; omit minor lines.

icons.name: class-features
icons.simplification16: Keep shield and vertical branch; reduce side branches to two.

icons.name: feat
icons.usage: feat, talent and acquired special ability
icons.simplification16: Keep star silhouette and check; drop small inner turns if they merge.

icons.name: death-save-success
icons.simplification16: Keep pulse, check and three circular slots; shorten pulse to two peaks.

icons.name: death-save-failure
icons.simplification16: Keep pulse, cross and three circular slots; shorten pulse to two peaks.

icons.name: door-open
icons.simplification16: Omit dashed swing arc; preserve angled leaf and wall gap.

icons.name: door-closed
icons.simplification16: Remove handle dot if crowded; preserve leaf across the gap.

icons.name: door-locked
icons.simplification16: Enlarge lock body and omit the door handle.

icons.name: window
icons.simplification16: Use two glass lines instead of three.

icons.name: wall
icons.simplification16: Reduce brick joints while preserving three horizontal courses.

icons.name: half-wall
icons.usage: low obstacle with partial sight and cover
icons.simplification16: Keep low brick block and one dashed height guide.

icons.name: pillar
icons.simplification16: Keep cap, shaft and centered circle; omit base interior edge.

icons.name: table
icons.simplification16: Keep tabletop and four short legs; remove one tabletop seam.

icons.name: console
icons.simplification16: Keep sloped body and screen; collapse keys into two marks.

icons.name: cryopod
icons.simplification16: Keep faceted capsule and head/body silhouette; omit upper/lower equipment rules.

icons.name: vision
icons.usage: line of sight and visible terrain
icons.simplification16: Keep eye outline and pupil; omit clock-hand detail.

icons.name: occlusion
icons.usage: blocked sight, occluded information or hidden content
icons.simplification16: Keep eye halves and dominant slash; remove inner partial arc.

icons.name: flashlight
icons.usage: portable cone light and flashlight inventory action
icons.simplification16: Keep body, lens and two light rays rather than three.

icons.name: alarm
icons.usage: alarm state, security alert or beacon
icons.simplification16: Keep beacon body and three rays; omit side horizontal rays.

icons.name: trap
icons.simplification16: Keep warning triangle and central mark; omit lower tripwire pattern.

icons.name: component-library
icons.simplification16: Keep four-cell grid with circle and plus; remove triangle interior detail.

icons.name: add
icons.simplification16: Keep the centered plus with a 2px optical margin.

icons.name: remove
icons.usage: remove an item without destructive-delete emphasis
icons.simplification16: Keep the centered horizontal rule.

icons.name: edit
icons.simplification16: Keep the pencil silhouette and enlarged tip; omit the shaft separator if needed.

icons.name: save
icons.simplification16: Keep outer disk, top slot and lower panel; omit inner lower edge.

icons.name: delete
icons.simplification16: Keep bin outline and one center divider rather than two.

icons.name: copy
icons.simplification16: Keep the two offset square silhouettes.

icons.name: undo
icons.simplification16: Keep the hooked return arrow with a larger arrowhead.

icons.name: redo
icons.simplification16: Keep the mirrored hooked return arrow with a larger arrowhead.

icons.name: refresh
icons.usage: refresh data, reconnect or recheck state
icons.simplification16: Keep the dominant circular arc and arrowhead; omit the short upper rule.

icons.name: search
icons.simplification16: Keep the lens and handle with no interior detail.

icons.name: zoom-in
icons.simplification16: Keep lens, handle and centered plus.

icons.name: zoom-out
icons.simplification16: Keep lens, handle and centered minus.

icons.name: fit-view
icons.usage: fit map or canvas within the viewport
icons.simplification16: Keep four corner brackets; omit the inner rectangle if crowded.

icons.name: settings
icons.simplification16: Keep six broad gear lobes and enlarge the center circle.

icons.name: open-folder
icons.usage: open a campaign, folder or local location
icons.simplification16: Keep folder tab and the sloped open flap.

icons.name: new-folder
icons.usage: create a new folder or collection
icons.simplification16: Keep folder outline and centered plus.

icons.name: download
icons.usage: download or save an external file
icons.simplification16: Keep down arrow and shallow tray.

icons.name: upload
icons.simplification16: Keep up arrow and shallow tray.

icons.name: import-file
icons.usage: import structured data into the application
icons.simplification16: Keep document silhouette and inbound arrow; omit folded-corner interior.

icons.name: export-file
icons.usage: export structured data from the application
icons.simplification16: Keep document silhouette and outbound arrow; omit folded-corner interior.

icons.name: close
icons.usage: close a dialog, panel or temporary surface
icons.simplification16: Keep the centered diagonal cross.

icons.name: confirm
icons.simplification16: Keep the check with a shortened leading stroke.

icons.name: warning
icons.simplification16: Reuse the existing warning triangle; omit the lower tripwire pattern at 16px.

icons.name: info
icons.simplification16: Keep the circle and merge the stem and dot into a clear information mark.

icons.name: play
icons.simplification16: Keep the centered play triangle.

icons.name: pause
icons.simplification16: Keep two broad vertical bars.

icons.name: stop
icons.simplification16: Keep the centered rounded square.

icons.name: next-turn
icons.usage: advance combat to the next turn
icons.simplification16: Keep two opposing turn arcs; remove the shortest tail rule if crowded.

icons.name: broadcast
icons.usage: live broadcast, stream or connection state
icons.simplification16: Keep center dot and one signal arc per side.

icons.name: monitor
icons.usage: player display, live view or external screen
icons.simplification16: Keep display rectangle and single center stand.

icons.name: sidebar-left
icons.usage: toggle or focus the left sidebar
icons.simplification16: Keep frame, left divider and inward chevron.

icons.name: sidebar-right
icons.usage: toggle or focus the right sidebar
icons.simplification16: Keep frame, right divider and inward chevron.

icons.name: book-open
icons.simplification16: Keep the center seam and two page silhouettes.

icons.name: book-open-text
icons.usage: rules text, chapter or detailed reference
icons.simplification16: Keep one short text rule per page.

icons.name: broom
icons.simplification16: Keep diagonal handle and broad bristle head; omit one bristle seam.

icons.name: campfire
icons.simplification16: Keep outer flame silhouette and crossed logs; omit inner flame turn.

icons.name: dice-six
icons.simplification16: Enlarge all six pips and preserve the rounded die frame.

icons.name: eraser
icons.usage: erase drawing strokes or map annotations
icons.simplification16: Keep angled eraser body and one separator; omit baseline.

icons.name: crosshair
icons.usage: target, center or precise map focus
icons.simplification16: Keep circle, four guides and center dot.

icons.name: film-strip
icons.simplification16: Keep film frame, two side rails and centered play mark; reduce perforations.

icons.name: flask
icons.simplification16: Keep neck, triangular vessel and liquid line; omit bubble dots.

icons.name: hand
icons.simplification16: Merge close finger seams while retaining thumb and palm silhouette.

icons.name: lightning
icons.usage: energy, action resource or quick effect
icons.simplification16: Keep the single angular bolt silhouette.

icons.name: map-pin
icons.usage: point of interest or map location
icons.simplification16: Keep pin outline and enlarged center ring.

icons.name: map-area
icons.usage: map region, revealed area or selected terrain
icons.simplification16: Keep outer region and three anchor points; omit one internal segment.

icons.name: map
icons.simplification16: Keep three folded panels; omit decorative route marks.

icons.name: moon-stars
icons.simplification16: Keep crescent and one four-point star.

icons.name: note
icons.usage: DM note, log entry or editable document
icons.simplification16: Keep document, folded corner and two text rules.

icons.name: scroll
icons.usage: rule scroll, lore or campaign document
icons.simplification16: Keep rolled top and bottom ends with one text rule.

icons.name: selection
icons.simplification16: Keep dashed boundary and two opposing corner handles.

icons.name: sliders-horizontal
icons.simplification16: Keep three rails and enlarge the three control knobs.

icons.name: stack
icons.usage: layers, stacked maps or grouped content
icons.simplification16: Keep top diamond and two lower layer edges.

icons.name: sword
icons.simplification16: Keep blade, crossguard and pommel; omit the inner blade separator.

icons.name: users
icons.simplification16: Keep primary person and one secondary shoulder silhouette.

icons.name: users-three
icons.usage: group, encounter roster or multiple participants
icons.simplification16: Keep central person and two side head arcs; omit side torso tails if crowded.
